names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 20 aprilie, «Sfântul Anastasie Sinaitul, Patriarhul Antiohiei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Αναστάσιος Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Αντιοχείας», with the rank words and the see left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 20. април ст. ст., „Блажени Анастасије Синаит.“, with the rank word Блажени left off. „Патријарх Антиохијски“ is the body's first sentence and not part of the heading; the rank and the see are what this folder keeps in `types` and `office` in any case. The by-name Синаит is kept: `anastasius-the-persian` already holds the bare «Анастасије».

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 20 апреля ст. ст., name page 168, «Святитель Анастасий I Синаит, Антиохийский, патриарх», with the rank words left off; the line itself gives «Анастасия I Синаита». Both epithets are kept, comma and all, because the bare forename is a wide fold in this corpus and because the next entry on the same day page is a different Anastasius who is also called Синаит. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'i анастасии антиохиискии синаит' has no other holder.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «s-a mutat către Domnul în al 14-lea an al împărăției lui Mavrichie, în anul 599».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 апреля ст. ст. — «Свтт. Григория (593), Анастасия I Синаита (599) , Патриархов Антиохийских.»
source.note: The second of the two patriarchs of Antioch on one line, with name page 168 and life900 of his own. The name page gives «День памяти: 20 апреля» and no other day. ONE READING LEFT UNRESOLVED: the life behind this line closes «мирно скончался (+ 21 апреля 599)», the twenty-FIRST of April, while this day page and his name page both keep him on the twentieth. The difference is one day and not thirteen, so it is neither the style conversion nor a second feast; nothing else on either page repeats the twenty-first, and under BRIEF.md §8 the day page stands and he was not moved. The day page prints no hymn under his name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 20 aprilie — «Sfântul Anastasie Sinaitul, Patriarhul Antiohiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ής Απριλίου — «Άγιος Αναστάσιος Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Αντιοχείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It is the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it agrees with the Romanian on the year of his death, 599. The Greek adds the shape of his career: that he was an ascetic on mount Sinai at the beginning of the sixth century, went from Sinai to Antioch and became the representative there of the Church of Alexandria, that on the death of bishop Domnus of Antioch clergy and people raised him to that throne in 559, that the emperor Justin exiled him in 570 to Jerusalem on the pretext that he had squandered the Church's property, that he stayed there studying and writing until 593, when he returned to his throne, and that he died about 599. It opens by saying «Δυστυχώς για τον Άγιο Αναστάσιο έχουμε πολύ λίγες πληροφορίες για τη ζωή του» — unhappily we have very little information about his life — and it closes by refusing one thing the synaxarists assert: «Τώρα όσον άφορα το τέλος του, που οι Συναξαριστές σημειώνουν μαρτυρικό, ότι δηλαδή μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους, θετικές πληροφορίες δεν έχουμε», we have no positive information about the martyric end by the sword that the synaxarists note. That refusal is quoted here and no rank of martyr was added to this folder's `types` on the strength of it; the day's line still calls him Ιερομάρτυρας. The page's own 559, 570 and 593 are dates of events and were not made dates of the man. It prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 03.05.2026 (20. април ст. ст.) — „Блажени Анастасије Синаит.“
